summary: Epilogue Note. Seven years on, the survivors are happily settled; Mina and Jonathan's son is called Quincey after Quincey Morris, born on the day he died. They revisit Transylvania: every trace is gone, the castle stands in desolation. The record is almost all typescript, no authentic proof; Van Helsing says 'We want no proofs'.

scenes.title: The journey back to Transylvania
scenes.summary: Every trace of what had been is blotted out; the castle stands as before above a waste of desolation.
scenes.key_quote: Every trace of all that had been was blotted out.

scenes.title: Van Helsing with the boy
scenes.summary: The papers are taken from the safe; Van Helsing declares no proofs are needed.
scenes.key_quote: We want no proofs. We ask none to believe us!

objects.name: Safe with the papers
objects.description: Safe where the record (typescript, notebooks, memorandum) was kept since their return.
objects.quote: I took the papers from the safe where they had been ever since our return so long ago.

dialogue_samples.speaker: Van Helsing
dialogue_samples.line: We want no proofs. We ask none to believe us!
